scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/wallet build && bun run --cwd packages/mcp build && bun run --cwd packages/x402 build && bun packages/core/scripts/assemble.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run build && for p in test packages/core packages/core/test packages/wallet packages/wallet/test packages/mcp packages/mcp/test packages/x402 packages/x402/test; do tsc --noEmit -p $p || exit 1; done
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run --filter './packages/*' test
scripts.test:bun: bun run build && bun test --timeout 60000 packages/core/test packages/wallet/test test
scripts.prepare: bun run build && (git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "$(git config core.hooksPath)" ] && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true)
